 Common Questions 

## Frequently Asked Questions

Get answers to the most common questions about plastic surgery with Dr. Rafael Velasco Marín in Cancun.

### Is plastic surgery in Cancun safe?

Yes, plastic surgery in Cancun is highly safe when performed by a verified, and certified plastic surgeon operating within fully accredited, tier-one private hospital facilities.

### How much does plastic surgery cost in Cancun?

Plastic surgery in Cancun typically ranges from $1,350 USD for minor facial procedures to $12,440+ USD for comprehensive, post-bariatric body contouring, representing a 50% to 60% savings compared to US and Canadian pricing.

### How long do I need to stay in Cancun after surgery?

Most surgical procedures require an absolute minimum stay in Cancun of 7 to 10 days post-operation to guarantee proper healing before you are safely cleared to fly back home.

The length of your stay depends on the structural extent of the surgery, ranging from 3 days for a minor bichectomy up to 10 continuous days for major interventions like a mommy makeover or circumferential tummy tuck. This timeframe is driven by post-op drain management, wound sealing speeds, and mandatory in-person follow-up clearance consultations.

### What hospital is used for surgery in Cancun?

All complex surgical procedures are performed exclusively inside premier, fully accredited private hospitals in Cancun, such as Hospital Joya, ensuring maximum patient safety.

### Can I combine procedures in one trip?

Yes, combining multiple procedures into a single surgical trip is highly common and efficient, allowing you to achieve comprehensive results with a single recovery window.

### Do I need a visa for Mexico surgery?

Most medical travelers from the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom do not require a specialized medical visa to undergo surgery in Mexico; a standard tourist card (FMM) obtained upon arrival is sufficient.

Visa requirements depend strictly on your country of citizenship, your passport's expiration date (which must be valid for at least six months), and your total intended duration of stay in Quintana Roo. Travelers from countries outside the visa-waiver program must apply for a formal visitor visa at a Mexican consulate prior to departure.

### Why choose Dr. Rafael Velasco Marín for my plastic surgery in Cancun?

 Dr. Rafael Velasco Marín is a highly respected, board-certified plastic surgeon with over 30 years of specialization in aesthetic and reconstructive surgery. His commitment to patient safety and natural-looking results reflects his world-class expertise. 

### What are the benefits of having plastic surgery in Cancun, Mexico?

 Cancun offers tremendous benefits for medical tourists, including significant cost savings compared to the U.S. and Canada without compromising quality. You’ll also have access to modern medical facilities and recover in a serene tropical environment. 

### How do I start planning my plastic surgery trip to Cancun?

 Start by filling out our online inquiry form or contacting us via phone/WhatsApp. We’ll schedule a confidential consultation with Dr. Rafael Velasco Marín to discuss your goals and guide you through travel and appointment planning. 

### Are the medical facilities in Cancun safe and accredited?

 Yes. We partner with leading hospitals and clinics in Cancun that follow strict safety and patient-care standards. These facilities are equipped with advanced technology and staffed by experienced medical professionals.

Patient Safety Protocol

## An Unwavering Commitment to Your Safety

Before any patient enters the operating room, their health undergoes rigorous evaluation to ensure the safest possible surgical experience.

### Comprehensive Laboratory Analysis

Complete blood count, blood chemistry, blood typing, HIV screening, and coagulation tests to ensure optimal health status.

### Cardiorespiratory Evaluation

Chest X-ray and electrocardiogram assessment by a board-certified cardiologist to evaluate cardiovascular health.

### Specialized Anesthesia Consultation

Personal pre-operative meeting with your certified anesthesiologist to explain the complete anesthetic process.

## Understanding the Facelift Procedure

A facelift is a highly individualized procedure. Dr. Velasco Marín customizes each surgery to the patient's specific facial anatomy and aesthetic goals.

### What is a Facelift?

A facelift, or rhytidectomy, is a surgical procedure designed to reduce visible signs of aging in the face and neck. It addresses sagging skin, deep creases below the lower eyelids, folds along the nose extending to the corner of the mouth, and loose skin and excess fatty deposits under the chin and jaw.

### The Goal: Natural Rejuvenation

Dr. Velasco Marín's approach is not to create a 'pulled' or 'operated-on' look. The goal is to restore a more youthful, rested, and natural facial contour while preserving your unique facial expressions and identity. The incisions are strategically placed to be well-concealed within the hairline and natural creases.

## Your Facelift Recovery Timeline

Patience is key during recovery. Dr. Velasco Marín and his team will provide detailed post-operative instructions to ensure a smooth and comfortable healing process.

First 24-48 Hours

Rest with head elevated. Bandages will be in place. Mild discomfort, swelling, and bruising are normal.

Week 1

Follow-up appointment to remove sutures. Swelling and bruising peak and begin to subside. Light activity can be resumed.

Weeks 2-4

Most swelling and bruising will have resolved. You can gradually return to non-strenuous work and social activities.

1-3 Months

Final results become more apparent as residual swelling subsides. You can typically resume all normal activities, including exercise.

Is It Right For You?

## Are You a Good Candidate for a Facelift?

The best way to determine your candidacy is through a personal consultation. However, ideal candidates generally share these characteristics.

### Ideal Candidates Often...

*   Have visible signs of facial aging like sagging skin and deep wrinkles.
*   Are in good physical health and non-smokers.
*   Have realistic expectations about the surgical outcome.
*   Are looking for a significant but natural-looking rejuvenation.

### May Not Be Ideal If You...

*   Have medical conditions that impair healing.
*   Are heavy smokers and unwilling to quit.
*   Have unrealistic expectations for perfection.
*   Are primarily concerned with fine lines or skin texture (other treatments may be better).

Schedule a Candidacy Assessment

Common Questions

## Facelift FAQs

Find answers to frequently asked questions about facelift surgery.

### What is the best age for a facelift?

There's no 'best' age. Candidacy depends on individual signs of aging, skin elasticity, and overall health, not chronological age. Patients are typically in their 40s to 60s, but older patients can also be great candidates.

### How long do facelift results last?

A facelift can turn back the clock by about 10 years, but it doesn't stop the aging process. Results are long-lasting, but your face will continue to age naturally. A healthy lifestyle can help maintain the results for as long as possible.

### Will I have noticeable scars?

Dr. Velasco Marín is an expert in placing incisions within the natural contours of the hairline and around the ear, making them very discreet. Over time, they fade significantly and are typically difficult to detect.

### Can a facelift be combined with other procedures?

Yes, very commonly. A facelift is often combined with procedures like eyelid surgery (blepharoplasty), a brow lift, or fat grafting to achieve more comprehensive facial rejuvenation.

### Have More Questions?

A personal consultation is the best way to get all your specific questions answered.

Procedure Overview

## Understanding Blepharoplasty

Blepharoplasty, or eyelid surgery, is a precise procedure to rejuvenate the appearance of your eyes. Dr. Velasco Marín expertly addresses sagging upper eyelids, under-eye bags, and excess skin to restore a more youthful, refreshed look.

### What Blepharoplasty Achieves

Remove excess skin from upper and/or lower eyelids.

Reduce under-eye bags and puffiness.

Improve vision by lifting droopy upper eyelids.

Restore a more youthful, alert appearance.

### Types of Blepharoplasty

#### Upper Blepharoplasty

Removes excess skin and fat from the upper eyelids to open the eyes and improve vision.

#### Lower Blepharoplasty

Addresses bags and puffiness under the eyes by removing or repositioning fat deposits.

### The Procedure

Typically performed under local anesthesia with sedation, blepharoplasty involves precise incisions hidden in the natural creases of the eyelids. Dr. Velasco Marín's meticulous technique ensures minimal scarring and natural-looking results.

## Your Blepharoplasty Recovery Timeline

Recovery from eyelid surgery is typically faster than other facial procedures. Dr. Velasco Marín provides comprehensive care instructions for optimal healing.

Apply cold compresses to reduce swelling. Keep your head elevated when resting. Some bruising and discomfort are normal.

Are You a Candidate?

## Ideal Candidates for Blepharoplasty

Blepharoplasty can significantly improve both appearance and function. The best candidates are those bothered by the signs of aging around their eyes or experiencing vision problems due to droopy eyelids.

*   Have droopy or sagging upper eyelids that may impair vision.
*   Experience under-eye bags or puffiness that makeup cannot conceal.
*   Are in good overall health and have realistic expectations.
*   Are non-smokers or willing to quit before and after surgery.
*   Have stable eye health with no serious eye conditions.

### Age is Just a Number

Blepharoplasty can be performed at various ages. The key factor is the presence of specific concerns, not your chronological age. Dr. Velasco Marín will assess your individual situation during consultation.

 Common Questions 

## Blepharoplasty FAQs

Your questions about blepharoplasty surgery.

### Will blepharoplasty improve my vision?

 If droopy upper eyelids are obstructing your field of vision, upper blepharoplasty can indeed improve your sight by removing the excess skin that hangs over your eyes. Dr. Velasco Marín will assess this during your consultation. 

### How visible will the scars be after eyelid surgery?

 Dr. Velasco Marín places incisions strategically within the natural creases of your eyelids, making scars virtually invisible once healed. The delicate nature of eyelid skin also helps scars fade beautifully over time. 

### Can I wear contact lenses after blepharoplasty?

 You will need to avoid wearing contact lenses for about 1-2 weeks after surgery to allow proper healing. Dr. Velasco Marín will provide specific guidelines based on your healing progress. 

### How long do the results of blepharoplasty last?

 Results are long-lasting, typically 10-15 years or more. While the natural aging process continues, many patients enjoy their refreshed appearance for many years. The removed excess skin will not return.

## What is Otoplasty?

Otoplasty, or cosmetic ear surgery, is a procedure designed to change the shape, position, or size of the ears. It is commonly performed to "pin back" ears that protrude prominently, but can also correct overly large ears or dissatisfaction with previous surgery.

### Primary Goals of Otoplasty

Corrects prominent or protruding ears.

Improves symmetry and facial balance.

Addresses dissatisfaction with ear size or shape.

Can be performed on both children (ages 5+) and adults.

### A Procedure for All Ages

Dr. Velasco Marín performs otoplasty on both children and adults. For children, it's often done around age 5 or 6 when the ears have reached near-full size. For adults, it can be performed at any time to boost self-esteem.

The goal is to create a natural shape while bringing balance and proportion to the ears and face. Incisions are discreetly placed behind the ear.

### Your Consultation

During your consultation, Dr. Velasco Marín will evaluate your facial structure, discuss your goals, and explain the surgical technique that will achieve the most natural and pleasing result for you.

Recovery Journey

## Otoplasty Recovery

Your journey back to daily life after ear surgery is well-supported and typically straightforward.

1 Week

### Initial Healing

A headband is worn continuously. Swelling and bruising are normal. Most patients can return to non-strenuous activities.

1-2 Weeks

### Return to Work/School

Stitches are removed. The headband is worn at night. Most swelling subsides. Return to school or desk jobs is usually possible.

4-6 Weeks

### Resuming Activities

Contact sports and strenuous activities can typically be resumed. The ears will be closer to their final position.

3-6 Months

### Final Results

Final shape and position of the ears are fully settled. Scars are well-healed and discreetly hidden.

* Recovery timelines are estimates and can vary based on individual healing.

Am I a Candidate?

## Are You a Candidate for Otoplasty?

Otoplasty is a highly effective procedure for both children and adults seeking to improve the appearance of their ears.

### Ideal Candidates

Individuals bothered by the prominence or shape of their ears.

Children whose ear cartilage is stable (typically age 5 and older).

Healthy individuals without medical conditions that can impair healing.

Non-smokers or those willing to quit before and after surgery.

Patients with realistic expectations for improvement.

### Not Suitable If

Individuals with unrealistic expectations about the outcome.

People with severe chronic illnesses or active ear infections.

Patients who are not able to follow post-operative care instructions.

 Common Questions 

## Otoplasty FAQs

Common questions about ear surgery answered by our experts.

### What is the best age for a child to have otoplasty?

The ideal age is typically around 5 to 6 years old. At this point, the ears have reached about 90% of their adult size, and the cartilage is still pliable, making it easier to reshape. Performing the surgery before school starts can also help prevent potential teasing.

### Will the scars from otoplasty be visible?

Dr. Velasco Marín places incisions strategically within the natural creases of your eyelids, making scars virtually invisible once healed. The delicate nature of eyelid skin also helps scars fade beautifully over time. 

### Is otoplasty a painful procedure?

The procedure itself is performed under anesthesia, so there is no pain. Post-operative discomfort is typically mild to moderate and is well-managed with prescribed pain medication. Most patients report more of a dull ache than sharp pain.

### Are the results of otoplasty permanent?

Yes, the results of otoplasty are considered permanent. The reshaped cartilage will hold its new position for a lifetime.
